notes: Read all three target units, full United Kingdom postal-worker context, all fifteen candidates and the review. Resolved the international struggle as DSA's labor struggle. Identified the Communication Workers Union fight through its supplied Royal Mail breakup, contract-security and labor-government demands. Also restored the explicit description of Senator Bernie Sanders as DSA-endorsed.

claims.claim_text: DSA-endorsed presidential candidate Senator Bernie Sanders had recently raised a shorter workweek without lost pay after the Labour Party adopted it as policy.
DSA recognizes its labor struggle as international.

DSA identifies the Communication Workers Union's fights against Royal Mail breakup, for a secure improved contract, and for a socialist Labour government pursuing public postal ownership and shorter hours without lost pay as DSA's own fight.
